identity.wine_style: Cool climate unoaked Chardonnay

style_markers.oak: none to subtle old oak depending on producer and level
style_markers.body: light to medium; premier cru and grand cru have more body
flavour_profile: citrus rather than green apple in premier cru and grand cru

style_markers.finish: medium to long, driven by acidity and citrus-mineral persistence
style_markers.quality_level: Petit Chablis, Chablis, Chablis Premier Cru, Chablis Grand Cru hierarchy
style_markers.ageing_potential: drink now to medium-term ageing; premier cru and grand cru examples can develop further bottle complexity

memory_hooks: Chablis equals Chardonnay in a cool, acid-led voice

common_exam_points: Chablis permits Chardonnay only
